name: The colour purple
description: Photograph one solid object that is clearly at least 75% purple, at least 10 × 10 cm, and out in the world. It cannot be something your team brought, carries, or wears.

name: The battle for France
description: Buy two whole baguettes at least 25 cm long, then post a photo or short video of two team members mock sword fighting with them. Both baguettes must be clearly visible.

name: The letter Q
description: Find and photograph a real, physical capital Q. It cannot be handwritten by your team, something you carry or wear, or on a movable screen. A fixed departure board or train display counts.

name: Bird spotter
description: Post one continuous video of at least 10 seconds showing the same wild bird in frame for the whole clip. It must be a real bird, not a picture, pet, or screen.

name: Touch grass
description: Post a photo of a recognisable team member touching real grass rooted in the ground outdoors. Clippings, potted plants, and artificial turf do not count.

name: No kiosk
description: At a station with no kiosk shop at all, buy something from a different shop and photograph the purchase with both shop and station visible.

name: Build your own flag
description: Collect three separate, similarly sized red, white, and blue items during the game and stack them in that order to form the Dutch flag. None may be items brought or worn at the start.

name: Old stuff
description: Photograph a team member with a recognisable object or building on the official Rijksmonument register, and include its name or address when submitting.

name: Bus stop
description: Post a photo that genuinely reads as waiting at a bus stop. A real bus stop is fine, or a clever staged version if it is convincing at a glance.

name: Too many letters
description: Photograph a clearly legible station-name board with at least 18 letters in its name, excluding spaces and hyphens.

name: Cow
description: From on board a train, photograph at least one real cow in a field with the train window frame visible.

name: The bridge
description: Post a photo showing a team member on top of or underneath a bridge, or your train crossing one. It must be unmistakable which version you are claiming.

name: The fake phone
description: Using two bananas, post one continuous 15-second video of two team members acting out a dramatic fake phone call. Both people and both bananas must stay in frame.

name: The snack zone
description: Buy a typical Dutch snack during the game, then post a continuous video of a team member opening it, eating it, and giving a spoken review in one shot.

name: Your team's flag
description: Using one blank A4 sheet and markers, make a flag for your team within 15 minutes. Post a photo of the finished flag with your team name included.

name: The knight
description: Outside trains and stations, use a reasonably straight stick or pole at least 100 cm long to perform a full knighting ceremony, including the specified spoken line.

name: Station to station
description: Choose an official NS walking route, then post photos of a team member at each of its two endpoint stations and name the route. You do not have to walk it.

name: Zoologist
description: Spot a real living animal in a station or train and post a photo or short video that makes the location clear. It cannot be a human, image, logo, stuffed toy, or animal brought by your team.
